summary: Comprehensive testing of Account-First Flow overhaul. All 19 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend routing and UI tests pass. Account-first flow correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /signup before Stripe checkout. Ghost user prevention working - webhook returns no_user for unregistered emails. Admin dashboard correctly reads from auth_users collection.
critical_code_review_comments: Account-first flow correctly stores pending_plan in localStorage and redirects to /signup when clicking 'Get Started' while not logged in
SignUp page shows pending plan banner with plan name and changes button text to 'Create Account & Continue to Checkout'
After signup with pending_plan, user correctly redirected to Stripe checkout with prefilled_email parameter
Logged-in users clicking 'Get Started' are correctly redirected directly to Stripe (not to /signup)
Login page shows Email/Phone + Password fields - no license key fields present
Login with active subscription correctly redirects to /app
Login without subscription correctly redirects to /pricing
Unauthenticated user trying to access /app correctly redirected to /login
Authenticated user without subscription trying to access /app correctly redirected to /pricing
Ghost user prevention: Webhook with unregistered email returns no_user status (does NOT create license_key record)
Webhook with registered email correctly updates auth_users subscription_status to active
customer.subscription.deleted webhook correctly updates auth_users to cancelled
InfoNav shows Log In + Sign Up when NOT authenticated
InfoNav shows Choose a Plan + Log Out when authenticated without subscription
Admin dashboard Users tab shows auth_users data with email, subscription_tier, subscription_status
Admin stats endpoint returns user counts from auth_users collection (total, monthly, quarterly, annual, no_subscription, cancelled)

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all routing and UI tests pass

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed users created during testing (TEST_register_*, TEST_nosub_*, TEST_webhook_*, TEST_dup_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Account-first flow overhaul complete and verified. Key flows: 1) Unauthenticated user clicking 'Get Started' on /pricing stores pending_plan in localStorage and redirects to /signup. 2) /signup shows pending plan banner and redirects to Stripe after registration. 3) Logged-in users go directly to Stripe. 4) Webhook only updates existing auth_users (no ghost users). 5) Admin dashboard reads from auth_users collection. Test users: flowtest@example.com has active monthly subscription, testuser123@example.com also has active subscription now.
